lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#2 in EPA per play), while Atlanta Falcons owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#17 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Atlanta Falcons -0.4 with a fair total of 48.6 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is San Francisco 49ers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits +0.225 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: San Francisco 49ers and Atlanta Falcons have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
